Hi Elliot,

Thanks for speaking with our procurement and privacy teams last week. To complete the DPiA and Art.28/30 paperwork we need a technical export of processing evidence scoped to the Redwood services our integration will use. Specifically we need: 

- A bucketized export (CSV or NDJSON) of processing records for the past 12 months, split by environment (prod, staging, test).
- An excerpt from your Article 30 processing ledger showing subprocessors tied to the integration, timestamps and data categories.
- Proof of KMS wrapping / key management for onshore copies and any regional routing that affected data residency.

Can you confirm:
1) The earliest ETA you can provide an export sample for review (we'd prefer onshore samples),
2) Whether you can grant temporary auditor access to an S3 bucket or a shared Drive for our privacy team, and
3) Any non-disclosure steps or portal we should expect for retrieving the artifacts.

We'd like to avoid an onsite inspection if possible — a secure remote export is fine. Please CC your privacy lead and ops colleague who will coordinate the extract.

Best,
Kate Miller
Privacy Manager
Midwest Health

Hi Kate — thanks, and great to meet you over the call last week. We'll handle this as a priority. Quick answers up-front and a suggested plan: 

1) ETA: we can deliver a redacted sample export within 48 hours and the full scoped export (bucketized by env) within 5 business days given standard access approvals.
2) Access: we can provide a time-bound S3 presigned bundle or a shared Drive link with two-factor access; auditors can be given read-only access for a defined window.
3) NDA/portal: no additional NDA beyond the standard onboarding NDA should be necessary, but we can use our secure evidence portal (link below) to stage artifacts.

Suggested deliverables:
- dpia_bucket_manifest.csv — manifests listing object keys and record counts by environment.
- art30_ledger_excerpt.csv — excerpt with subprocessors and processing categories (PII flags redacted on the sample).
- evidence-access-instructions.pdf — step-by-step for downloading with presigned links and auditor roles.

I have CC'd Marissa (ops) to author the ledger extract and Irene (privacy ops) to confirm KMS/key-wrap logs and retention metadata. If you confirm auditor emails and preference for S3 vs Drive we will proceed.

Link to staging portal (internal): https://redwood-evidence.example/staging/HS-49821

Thanks,
Elliot
Director, Customer Privacy Operations
Redwood Inference

Thanks — let me know if you need a ticket for infra to escalate.
